description: Get the user's LinkedIn résumé: bio, work history, education, skills, certifications, projects, languages, awards, publications, and more. Use for questions about who they are professionally, their background, or qualifications.

domains.description: Sections to include. Defaults cover the core résumé: bio, work history, education, skills, certifications, projects. Add more for fuller picture: PROFILE (bio), POSITIONS (work history), EDUCATION, SKILLS, CERTIFICATIONS, PROJECTS, LANGUAGES, HONORS (awards), COURSES, PUBLICATIONS, PATENTS, ORGANIZATIONS (memberships), VOLUNTEERING_EXPERIENCES, RECOMMENDATIONS, PROFILE_SUMMARY.

maxPagesPerDomain.description: Max pages of results to fetch (1–25). Each page holds ~10 records. Lower this to keep responses small.

name: linkedin_get_profile

apiVersion.description: LinkedIn API version used for the request.

domains.description: Records grouped by section name (e.g. POSITIONS, EDUCATION). Each value is the list of items in that section.

metadata.description: Per-section fetch stats. Check truncated to detect partial results.

truncated.description: True if more results exist beyond the page limit.

title: Get LinkedIn résumé
